findings.detail: All285 host files match original arrival ZIP members, including all99 fixed-prefixed and184 uniform-prefixed files from their intended archives.

Host README/article are unchanged first-release originals; second-release README/article and both original PDFs have no identical placed counterpart. The second proof/evidence packet is ancillary placement, not integrated main prose.

Host README is the original release guide, with historical PDF/manuscript/inputs/tools/qa paths absent from the flattened host; its replay and publication descriptions are not a current host manifest.

K and Boolean table S are fixed data; inputs A,B remain unbounded positive integers but are clipped at K. Exact zero/one positive-witness classification allows degree/coefficient dependence on all table data and gives no uniform paid arithmetic universal compiler.

Placed main article retains fixed-order asymptotics. Uniform ancillary text treats every exact finite truncation0<=M<2n for n>=32, but does not establish growing-order logarithmic/inverse expansions or a fixed polynomial for arbitrary histories.

hash_convention: Raw SHA256 file bytes; read spans inclusive UTF8 lines with original endings. Matching duplicate bytes share the stated text-read coverage. ZIP directories are excluded from file-member counts; nested archives are hashed, not recursively audited.
